Amsterdam-based speech recognition startup Resonate Labs B.V. today released its Rumble-2-Flash transcription model as a free download with open weights. Designed for fast transcription of prerecorded audio, the 500 million-parameter model supports more than 40 languages. Reson8 is pitching the release at developers and researchers who need speech recognition built for languages other than English.
